section: Summary of Benefits for the Elevate Plus Option of the Government Employees Health Association, Inc. 2026

rows.Elevate Plus Benefits: Medical services provided by physicians: Diagnostic and treatment services provided in the office
rows.You pay: In-network: Nothing for preventive care; $30 copay primary care provider; $50 copay specialist

rows.Elevate Plus Benefits: Services provided by a hospital: Inpatient
Services provided by a hospital: Outpatient

rows.You pay: In-network: 25%* of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: Emergency care is paid at the in-network level

rows.Elevate Plus Benefits: Mental health and substance use disorder treatment:

rows.You pay: Network pharmacy: • Generic: Member pays lesser of $15 or pharmacy's usual and customary cost for 30-day supply • Preferred Brand: Member pays lesser of $100 or pharmacy's usual and customary cost for 30-day supply • Non-Preferred Brand: Member pays 50% of Plan allowance for 30-day supply

Mail order network: • Generic: Member pays lesser of $20 or the cost of the drug for 90- day supply • Preferred Brand: Member pays lesser of $200 or the cost of the drug for 90-day supply • Non-Preferred Brand: Member pays 50% of Plan allowance for 90-day supply
Accidental Dental coverage only. Services are paid at regular medical Plan benefits.
